Aurelio Diaz

A Division Agent in Broken Dawn whose investigation joins April Kelleher's Midwest antiviral trail and the novel's Washington intelligence handoff.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-28

Agent on the research trail

Aurelio is one of Broken Dawn's named SHD Agents. The official premise places him beside April Kelleher as the inquiry moves out of the original game's New York setting. [1][2]

Ann Arbor operation

The licensed novel makes Aurelio part of the source-specific effort to safeguard the research lead and counter the operation tied to Mantis. That connection does not identify Mantis's organization beyond what the novel establishes. [3]

Claim ledger
